run_GTestFilterUnitTest: run the googletest filter unit test suite to verify test filtering and sharding behavior
test_SetEnvVar: test the SetEnvVar utility function that sets or unsets environment variables for subprocess invocation
test_RunAndExtractTestList: test the RunAndExtractTestList utility that parses gtest output to extract the list of tests run
test_InvokeWithModifiedEnv: test the InvokeWithModifiedEnv utility that runs a function with temporary environment variable changes
test_RunWithSharding: test the RunWithSharding utility that runs a test program shard and returns exit code and tests run
